# NWChem logs

Logs of NWChem 7.3.1 (`mpirun -np 2 nwchem input.nw`) for the `realNwchemLogs` test of `test_results`, with
what MolForma reads from each in the `.json` beside it. The inputs were generated by MolForma: water
(and a water dimer, butane, planar NH3 and OH) with the settings the name tells, at small basis sets so that
the logs stay short. `water_error` uses a basis set that does not exist and ends in an NWChem error. The
host name and source path in the job information were replaced.

When the reading changes on purpose, record it anew with `MOLFORMA_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 ./build/test_results
realNwchemLogs` and check the difference of the `.json` files.
